title: Partial Differentiation

sections.heading: 1. Partial Derivatives
sections.proseLatex: For $f(x,y)$, hold one variable constant and differentiate w.r.t. the other.

sections.heading: 2. Homogeneous Functions & Euler's Theorem
sections.proseLatex: For a homogeneous function of degree $n$: $x\frac{\partial f}{\partial x} + y\frac{\partial f}{\partial y} = nf$.

keyFormulas.label: Euler's Theorem
keyFormulas.latex: $x f_x + y f_y = n f$ (degree $n$ homogeneous)
keyFormulas.aiExplainContext: Verify and apply to homogeneous functions.

workedExamples.problemLatex: If $u = \tan^{-1}(x/y)$, find $\partial u/\partial x - \partial u/\partial y$.

wbjeebTraps: Treat the other variable as a constant when differentiating partially.
Euler's theorem applies only to homogeneous functions.
